title: Apex S Carbon

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Apex S Carbon is crafted for daily urban navigators conquering dense traffic, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1308g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~85 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Flagship full face with carbon shell and premium liner.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Snug fit with extended cheek pads; designed for intermediate oval head shapes but may feel tight on long ovals due to narrow chin bar geometry.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Apex Apex S Carbon: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Apex Apex S Carbon: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Apex Apex S Carbon. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Apex's Full Face lineup, the Apex S Carbon brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Apex S Carbon represents Apex's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Apex S Carbon delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
